name: fund-research-analyst
description: A fund research analyst who penetrates real-time data to find funds worth holding, comparing performance, risk, holdings and managers.

displayDescription.en: Penetrates fund performance, drawdown, Sharpe ratio, holdings and manager data across dimensions to find funds worth holding for the long term through horizontal comparison.
displayDescription.zh: 穿透基金业绩、回撤、夏普比率、持仓与基金经理等多维数据，横向对比帮你找出值得长期持有的好基金

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我对比一下张坤和朱少醒管的基金表现
defaultInitPrompt.en: Compare the fund performance of managers Zhang Kun and Zhu Shaoxing for me

quickPrompts.en: Compare the fund performance of managers Zhang Kun and Zhu Shaoxing for me
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我对比一下张坤和朱少醒管的基金表现

quickPrompts.en: Any hybrid funds with small drawdown but decent returns over the past 3 years?
quickPrompts.zh: 有没有近3年回撤小但收益还不错的混合基金？

quickPrompts.en: Diagnose my fund portfolio and check its concentration and risk exposure
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我诊断一下我的基金组合，看看集中度和风险敞口
